proposals.summary: The free tier is now a 14-day free trial of the Team plan.
proposals.previous_state: Localization management. The Free plan is $0 a month: 60,000 hosted words, 1 private project, unlimited public projects, 1 integration, unlimited translators and Crowdin AI. Users on the Free plan donate their translations to Crowdin's translation memory. Pro starts at $50 a month (2 private projects), Team at $150 and Team+ at $450. Open-source and non-profit projects can apply for a free Open Source License. The CDN for over-the-air translations is free up to 1M requests and 10 GB of data transfer. CLI, GitHub integration, REST API
proposals.current_state: The Team plan is available for a 14-day free trial.

proposals.summary: The free tier still exists. The page details a 'Starter' plan with 10 GB per transfer and 100 GB of storage, available for 3 EUR/month. Previously info states 5 GB per transfer and 100 GB of storage for the free tier.
proposals.previous_state: simplest, fastest and safest interface to transfer and share files — TransferNow Free – 5 GB per transfer to send and receive files quickly and for free. 100 GB of storage. Retention up to 7 days.
proposals.current_state: Free plan offers 5 GB per transfer and no storage. Starter plan offers 10 GB per transfer and 100 GB of storage for 3 EUR/month.

restatement.description: simplest, fastest and safest interface to transfer and share files — Free plan offers 5 GB per transfer and no storage. Starter plan offers 10 GB per transfer and 100 GB of storage for 3 EUR/month.

proposals.summary: The free Starter plan now includes 25k AI credits, whereas previously it included none. The page also states a 45-day free trial of the Growth Plus plan is available before needing to subscribe.
proposals.previous_state: Headless CMS with visual editor for developers and marketers — Starter plan is free and includes 1 space, 1 user seat (with an additional seat available for $15/month), 100GB traffic/month, 100k API requests/month, 2 locales, 200 components, 20,000 stories, 2,000 assets, 1 day content versioning retention, 500MB max asset size, and 3 webhooks.
proposals.current_state: Monthly price if billed monthly: Free. Includes 1 team member seat, add 1 more user at $15.00 /month. Start with: 1 space, 1 user seat included, up to 2 user seats at $15.00 /month, 100GB traffic/month, 100k API requests/month, 2 locales, 25k AI credits.

proposals.summary: The free tier now has different limits. Database rows are 5,000,000, File Storage is 500 GB, Serverless Computing is 200 GB-Hours, and Client App Users are 10,000. Previously rows: 2,500, Storage: 500, Serverless computing: 1Gb/h, and client app users: 5.
proposals.previous_state: 8base is a full-stack low-code development platform built for JavaScript developers built on top of MySQL and GraphQL and serverless backend-as-a-service. It allows you to start building web applications quickly using a UI app builder and scale quickly, The Free tier includes rows: 2,500, Storage: 500, Serverless computing: 1Gb/h, and client app users: 5.
proposals.current_state: The Free tier includes Database Rows 5,000,000, File Storage 500 GB, Serverless Computing 200GB-Hours, and Client App Users 10,000.

proposals.summary: The free tier now offers 1 GB of storage instead of 500 MB.
proposals.previous_state: Proton Free offers 500 MB storage (expandable to 1 GB), 1 user, and 1 encrypted email address.

proposals.summary: The free tier is now the 'Starter plan' and is for local development and small projects.
proposals.previous_state: Backend framework with static analysis for automatic infrastructure provisioning. Free cloud hosting for hobby projects, up to 2 environments, built-in monitoring and tracing
proposals.current_state: The Starter plan is free for local development and small projects. The Pro plan is $49 per team member per month, plus per-environment and per-resource fees.

proposals.summary: The free tier now has a daily limit of 100 emails, matching previously.
proposals.previous_state: Developer-first email API — 3K emails/month free (100/day cap), 3 domains, 1K marketing contacts/month, 5 AI credits, 30-day data retention

proposals.summary: The Hobby plan still exists and is $0/month, but many limits are now 'starting at' a price, meaning they are no longer included in the free tier. Specifically, data transfer, blob storage, image transformations, function invocations, and compute resources all have associated costs beyond the included amounts.
proposals.previous_state: Hobby plan, $0 a month, for non-commercial personal use only. Includes 100 GB Fast Data Transfer, 1M Edge Requests, 1M Function Invocations, 4 hours Fluid Active CPU, 360 GB-hrs Fluid Provisioned Memory, 1 GB Blob Storage and 5K image transformations a month. Hobby accounts are limited to these caps and cannot buy more usage. Pro is $20 a month with one deploying seat; each additional deploying seat is $20 a month.
proposals.current_state: Hobby $0 /mo. Includes 1M CDN Requests, 100 GB Fast Data Transfer, 1M Function Invocations, 4 hours Fluid Active CPU, 360 GB-hrs Fluid Provisioned Memory, 1 GB Blob Storage and 5K image transformations a month, but all of these have 'starting at' costs beyond the included amounts.

It highlights features like memory, AI agents, and integrations with tools like Stripe, Slack, and GitHub. Users can build dashboards, portals, CRMs, and trackers.
